items.question: Can I build a CV for free?
items.answer: Yes. Core CV building, template selection, and PDF export are completely free.

items.question: Where is my CV data stored?
items.answer: Your data is stored in your browser (local storage) and is never sent to a server.

items.question: Is the PDF free?
items.answer: Yes, PDF export is free for all users.

items.question: What does the Pro plan include?
items.answer: DOCX export, advanced ATS analysis, job description matching, Cover Letter, and QR code, among other features.

items.question: Can I upload a photo?
items.answer: Yes, you can add, crop, and edit a profile photo on your CV.

items.question: How can I back up my CV data?
items.answer: You can export your CV as a JSON file and restore it at any time.
